summary: Re-verified Moka backend fix for POST /api/billing/checkout schema drift (iteration_2 HIGH bug). All 10 regression tests pass 100%. Checkout now returns 200 with a hosted Stripe checkout URL for both pro_yearly and pro_monthly using the TRIAL bearer; no 500 and payment_transactions row persists without schema errors. Regressions (health, billing packages, value engine, teams/players sample, TRIAL and EXPIRED entitlements) all green.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotent ALTER TABLE migration for payment_transactions in database.py is correct pattern; consider adding similar guard for future schema evolutions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_moka_regression.py covers health, billing packages+checkout (monthly+yearly), value engine, teams, and TRIAL/EXPIRED entitlements. Sports data is intentionally sample/mock.
rca of the issue: iteration_2 500 on /api/billing/checkout was due to payment_transactions table missing columns (email, package_id, metadata, payment_status, mode, updated_at). Main agent added them to CREATE TABLE and added idempotent ALTER TABLE migration in init_db. Verified via successful checkout + persistence.
